# Outbridge Inc — Full Reference

> Outbridge Inc is a Santa Clara-based outsourcing / BPO firm that places vetted virtual assistants, customer support agents, sales reps, and full back-office teams. Talent is secure, multilingual, and aligned to clients' US & EU business hours.

- Website: https://outbridgeinc.com
- Contact: hello@outbridgeinc.com
- Headquarters: Santa Clara, California, USA
- Languages: English, French, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic
- Area served: United States, European Union, United Kingdom
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/outbridgeinc · Facebook: https://facebook.com/outbridgeinc · Instagram: https://instagram.com/outbridgeinc
- Last updated: 2026-06-20

## What Outbridge Inc is
Outbridge Inc recruits, vets, trains, and manages remote talent for growing companies, so clients get a reliable offshore/nearshore team without building one themselves. Engagements span a single virtual assistant to a full multi-seat BPO operation. Teams are matched to the client's tools, time zone, and language, and work under confidentiality and data-security controls.

## Services
1. Virtual Assistants — vetted remote assistants for administration, scheduling, inbox and calendar management, research, and day-to-day operations.
2. Customer Support Outsourcing — inbound customer support across live chat, email, and phone, including multilingual and 24/7 coverage models.
3. Outsourced Sales Agents — outbound and inbound sales development representatives for lead generation, qualification, and follow-up.
4. Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) — full back-office teams and managed processes (operations, data, finance support, and more).

## How engagements work
- Vetting: candidates are screened and tested before placement.
- Time-zone alignment: teams work in clients' US and EU business hours, including overnight coverage where needed.
- Languages: support delivered in English, French, Spanish, Mandarin, Urdu, Hindi, and Arabic.
- Security: confidentiality and data-handling controls on every engagement (see Compliance).
